run_superglue_matching: run SuperGlue inference to match keypoints between an RGB image and a goal image using the Matching forward method
create_matching_instance: create a Matching module instance with SuperPoint and SuperGlue config for image keypoint matching on a GPU device
extract_goal_keypoints: extract keypoints from a goal image using SuperPoint inference via the get_goal_image_keypoints method
visualize_keypoint_matches: visualize and save keypoint match plots between two images using the _make_matching_plot static method
set_visualization_directory: set the visualization output directory for a specific episode ID using the set_vis_dir method
